captions.detailed: A rigid road bike fork and steering assembly. It features a tapered steerer tube inside a grey headtube sleeve, sweeping down to curved black fork blades with flat silver dropouts. Above the headtube, a black threadless stem clamps the steerer tube and holds a drop-bar handlebar with a flat center and curved drops. The steering assembly is fully articulated, rotating smoothly around the steerer axis relative to the headtube.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a road bike fork and handlebar steering assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a grey headtube sleeve, a black rigid fork with curved blades and silver dropouts, a threadless stem, and a drop-bar handlebar, with a continuous rotational articulation defined around the steering axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. It models the headtube as a simple cylinder, the steerer tube and crown as cylinders and boxes, and the curved fork blades by sweeping or lofting along paths, ending in flat dropout boxes. The stem is built with a clamp cylinder, an angled extension box, and a faceplate, while the drop handlebar is constructed by sweeping a circular profile along a 3D path representing the flat section and curved drops. Finally, it defines a continuous joint (articulation) aligning the steering axis of the fork and handlebar assembly relative to the headtube.
